set.body:
Phase A (P0/P1 correctness hotfix, no public shape change). Six independent closures at danger boundaries.

1. RelativeOutputPath admits "." segments. core/Workload.scala:10-21 rejects a leading /, empty segments and "..", but NOT ".". So a/./b and a/b are distinct opaque values that resolve to the same file. OutputManifest.from (:67-77) and ResultContract.DeclaredOutputs.from (:115-123) dedupe by string equality, so both spellings pass duplicate detection and then collide on write. Reject "." and canonicalize.

2. Process executor lets exceptions escape the typed model. local/Fs2CommandExecutor.scala:80-86 catches IOException and SecurityException, then re-raises everything else. Same shape at ssh/SshProcessRunner.scala:130-134 and :196-203. An IllegalArgumentException or UnsupportedOperationException from ProcessBuilder escapes InvocationResult entirely. Contain all non-fatal exceptions.

3. Cursor overflow. core/Identifiers.scala:72 (EventCursor.next = cursor + 1L) and managed/ManagedModel.scala:23 (StoreRevision.next) both wrap to negative at Long.MaxValue, silently violating their own from invariant (>= 0) and inverting Order. The correct pattern is already in the codebase: AttemptEpoch.next returns Either and guards (kernel/Identifiers.scala:85-90). The review caught EventCursor and missed StoreRevision.

4. Unrestricted public construction. ResultContractDescriptor (core/Workload.scala:84-89), DurableResultHandle (core/StructuredResult.scala:29-41) and TaskInvocation (:43-57) expose public .apply/.copy with no smart constructor. They are the outliers in a file where ResultEnvelope is already `final case class ResultEnvelope private` (:15) and OutputEntry/OutputManifest/NativeOption/SiteToken/Axis/Grid/CommandPrefix are all private.

5. ContentDigest accepts arbitrary text. kernel/Identifiers.scala:73 extends TextIdentifier("contentDigest", 200), which only checks non-empty, <= 200 chars, no whitespace/control — so "x" is a valid ContentDigest. Producers already emit sha256:<hex> (managed/ManagedModel.scala:97, worker/FileTaskContext.scala:271) but every decoder accepts anything. Validate sha256:<64 hex>.

6. SiteToken is one type for account, partition, QoS, constraints, modules, container and accelerator kind (core/SiteProfile.scala:7-11, 29, 47-57, 89-101, 113). An account and a partition are freely interchangeable at the type level; SiteProfile.resolve (:170-172) only guards when an allowlist is configured. Introduce distinct site types. Lowest priority of the six — do not let it block 1-5.

Acceptance: one RED-against-parent test per closure. Note for item 5: tightening validation will reject non-conforming persisted digests; nothing is released and there are no tags, so no migration is believed necessary (epic open decision 3).
set.title: P8.A5: Close public invariant, path, process, and overflow holes
